summary: The EU finalized its 21st sanctions package targeting Russian long-range UAV manufacturers and defense entities while excluding a full LNG transport ban. Russian strikes on civilian vessels halted all shipping through Ukraine's Black Sea corridor, with at least three ships attacked and dozens of crew casualties. A Ukrainian drone destroyed a Russian Buk-M3 air defense system worth $50 million in Donetsk region.
key_points: EU adopted 21st sanctions package targeting 37 Russian long-range UAV producers and 56 defense-linked entities, but omitted full LNG maritime ban. (Source: @tass_agency/386715)
Russian attacks on at least three civilian cargo ships in Black Sea stopped all vessel traffic through Ukrainian corridor, killing and wounding dozens of crew. (Source: @UkraineNow/82850)
Ukrainian drone struck and destroyed Russian Buk-M3 system valued at $50 million in Donetsk region on night of July 23. (Source: @UkraineNow/82856)
Russian air defenses claimed 172 Ukrainian UAVs shot down over Russian regions and Black/Azov seas in a single day. (Source: @tass_agency/386726)
Ballistic missile threats reported from occupied Crimea (Iskander-M) and Kursk region (Iskander-M/S-300) toward Ukrainian territory. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69316)
Ireland announced €125 million aid package: €100M non-lethal military equipment, €25M critical infrastructure protection, plus €25M for air defense. (Source: @UkraineNow/82857)
Ukraine introduced new voluntary mobilization procedure allowing direct unit enrollment bypassing TCC, with 5-day protection from forced mobilization. (Source: @UkraineNow/82861)
Russia's oil and gas revenues may rise 60% year-on-year in July due to higher global oil prices, funding approximately one-fifth of federal budget. (Source: @UkraineNow/82866)

sections.executive_summary: The EU finalized its 21st sanctions package targeting 37 Russian long-range UAV manufacturers and 56 defense-linked entities while excluding a full ban on LNG maritime transport. Russian strikes on at least three civilian cargo vessels in the Black Sea have completely halted shipping through Ukraine's humanitarian corridor, resulting in dozens of crew casualties. A Ukrainian drone successfully destroyed a Russian Buk-M3 air defense system valued at $50 million in Donetsk region, marking a significant asymmetric strike.

points: Ukrainian drone destroyed a Russian Buk-M3 air defense system worth $50 million in Donetsk region on the night of July 23, catching occupiers off guard after they moved the complex closer to the front line. (Source: @UkraineNow/82856)

Ukraine implemented a new voluntary mobilization procedure allowing candidates to interact directly with chosen military units without visiting Territorial Recruitment Centers; commanders can issue VLK referrals providing at least 5-day protection from forced mobilization. (Source: @UkraineNow/82861)

Deputy Prime Minister Mykhailo Fedorov declined presidential offer for other positions, insisting on remaining Defense Minister to continue implementing the AIR-LAND-ECONOMY plan aimed at protecting skies, stopping the front, and striking enemy economy. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23681)

Agrarian Policy Minister Taras Vysotsky confirmed ships have completely stopped calling at Ukrainian ports following Russian strikes; previously 4-5 ships visited regularly, but shipowners suspended calls independently. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31852)

President Zelensky met with Raytheon leadership to discuss joint production of Patriot missiles in Ukraine; company confirmed readiness for cooperation on Patriot manufacturing and other non-offensive military equipment partnerships. (Source: @UkraineNow/82863)
Russian forces struck fuel unloading infrastructure in the port of Yuzhny, part of ongoing attacks on Black Sea maritime logistics. (Source: @tass_agency/386727)
Russian air defense claimed destruction of 172 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions and Black/Azov sea waters in a single day. (Source: @tass_agency/386726)
Emergency regime declared in Nevinnomyssk after UAV strike caused fire at Wildberries warehouse; governor confirmed UAV attack as cause. (Source: @tass_agency/386724)

Russia's oil and gas revenues projected to increase 60% year-on-year in July due to rising global oil prices, constituting approximately one-fifth of federal budget revenues financing the war. (Source: @UkraineNow/82866)
Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov met with US Secretary of State Rubio in Manila on ASEAN summit sidelines for 35 minutes; no details of conversation disclosed. (Source: @UkraineNow/82846)
Fighters from the "Center" group reportedly liberated the town of Belitskoye near Dobropolye in Donetsk People's Republic. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31853)

New Commander-in-Chief Drapaty characterized Donbas residents as "irresponsible" wanting "freebies," citing historical population by displaced persons and criminal elements, and insufficient Ukrainization efforts. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31860)
Ukrainian drone struck Russian Buk-M3 system in Donetsk region, demonstrating continued asymmetric targeting of high-value air defense assets near front lines. (Source: @UkraineNow/82856)
Extensive UAV activity reported across Donetsk region with multiple jet-type drones maneuvering near frontline areas. (Source: @eRadarrua/102314)

Multiple jet UAVs and Shahed drones launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region, specifically targeting Vyshhorod district with at least 3 Shaheds and groups of jet drones. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69327)
Ballistic missile threat alerts issued for Iskander-M/S-300 launches from Kursk region toward northern Ukrainian territories. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69313)

Sumy region experiencing intensive UAV activity: strike UAVs in groups of 3, plus jet drones heading toward Putyvl, Terny, Krolevets, and northern Poltava region toward Lokhvytsia, Chornukhy. (Source: @kpszsu/69843)

Chernihiv region serving as launch area for multiple jet UAV groups moving southwest toward Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions, with drones passing Olshivka, Horodnia, and Chornobyl zone. (Source: @kpszsu/69838)
Kyiv region air defense tracking jet UAV groups and strike drones approaching from northern vectors including Narodychi direction in Zhytomyr region. (Source: @kpszsu/69840)

Russian forces attacked at least three civilian cargo ships in Black Sea over recent days, killing and wounding dozens of crew members, leading to complete suspension of shipping through Ukrainian corridor. (Source: @UkraineNow/82850)
Kh-59 cruise missile detected heading toward Odesa; additionally 1-2 Onyx missiles targeted Odesa/Chornomorsk port infrastructure. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69310)
Ballistic missile threat from occupied Crimea via Iskander-M systems reported, increasing risk to southern Ukrainian regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69316)
Dnipropetrovsk region experiencing UAV transit: jet drones passing Marhanets, Sofiivka toward Kirovohrad region, and groups heading toward Kryvyi Rih via Nikopol. (Source: @kpszsu/69842)

Ship calls at Ukrainian ports completely suspended by shipowners' decision following Russian strikes; state imposed no restrictions according to Agrarian Minister Vysotsky. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31852)
Russian air defense claimed 172 Ukrainian UAVs destroyed over Russian regions and Black/Azov seas in 24 hours. (Source: @tass_agency/386726)
Ukrainian drone successfully destroyed Russian Buk-M3 system ($50M) in Donetsk region, exploiting unexpected approach after Russian relocation closer to front. (Source: @UkraineNow/82856)

Massive UAV activity across northern Ukraine: Chernihiv region launching multiple jet drone groups southwest; Sumy region deploying strike UAV groups and jet drones toward Kyiv, Poltava, and northeastern vectors. (Source: @eRadarrua/102297)
Shahed drones launched from Poltava region toward Cherkasy (Zolotonosha district) and from Kirovohrad region toward Dnipropetrovsk (Kryvyi Rih district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69315)
Kh-59 cruise missile and 1-2 Onyx missiles launched toward Odesa/Chornomorsk; ballistic missile threats from Crimea (Iskander-M) and Kursk (Iskander-M/S-300). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69310)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian missile and UAV threats remain high across multiple vectors: ballistic missiles from Crimea and Kursk region threaten northern and central Ukraine, while Kh-59 and Onyx missiles target southern port infrastructure. The complete cessation of Black Sea shipping after attacks on civilian vessels indicates Russia's ability to enforce a de facto blockade despite the humanitarian corridor. Ukrainian asymmetric strikes on high-value air defense assets like the Buk-M3 demonstrate growing capability to degrade Russian integrated air defense networks. The EU sanctions package's focus on long-range UAV production acknowledges the strategic threat of Russian drone warfare but omits energy sanctions that could more severely constrain military funding.
sections.regional_response: Ireland's €125 million package emphasizes non-lethal equipment and critical infrastructure protection ahead of winter, reflecting European focus on sustaining Ukrainian resilience. The EU's 21st sanctions package targeting 37 UAV manufacturers and 56 defense entities shows continued economic pressure, though Hungary's reported financial losses from sanctions-induced project cancellations reveal alliance fragility. The Rubio-Lavrov meeting in Manila, while brief and opaque, maintains a diplomatic channel amid battlefield escalation. Shipowners' independent suspension of Ukrainian port calls demonstrates commercial risk aversion overriding state assurances, potentially requiring stronger security guarantees or insurance mechanisms.
sections.intelligence_notes: Fedorov's refusal to leave the Defense Ministry signals internal political stability around the AIR-LAND-ECONOMY plan's implementation, particularly regarding procurement reform and asymmetric operations. Drapaty's disparaging remarks about Donbas population risk undermining mobilization efforts and civilian morale in contested regions. The new voluntary mobilization procedure could improve recruitment quality by matching volunteers directly with units, but the 5-day protection window may create administrative bottlenecks. Wildberries warehouse strike and predicted retaliation against Ukrainian retail/logistics chains (Silpo, ATB, Nova Poshta) indicates expanding economic warfare targeting civilian supply networks. Elevated ballistic threat warnings for Kyiv over coming days suggest imminent Russian missile campaign.
